Placentia among 186 cities tied for 289th in California for scam reports in June
S. M. Paul
Placentia was one of 186 cities tied for 289th among 474 California cities that had at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, recording one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
That matched the city's report total from the previous month.
The report showed a $44.90 loss from an online purchase scam. The item received was not as advertised. The seller said it ships from the U.S. but actually drop-ships from China. The company is based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada, and would not refund the merchandise.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to carry large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
